```{r}
#| label: outcomessubfunc
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false

outcomessubfunc_inner <- function(event, time, intvar, intvarname, model, novars = NULL) {
  levsint <- levels(escdata %>% pull(!!sym(intvar)))
  nlevsint <- length(levsint)
  modvarstmp <- setdiff(modvars, c(novars, intvar))
  out <- tibble(
    pop = NA_character_,
    est = NA_real_,
    se = NA_real_,
    p = NA_real_,
    pint = NA_real_,
    .rows = (nlevsint + 1)
  )

  out[, 1] <- c(intvarname, paste0("  ", levsint))

  for (i in seq_along(levsint)) {
    if (model == "log") {
      modraw <- with(
        impdata,
        glm(
          formula(paste0(
            event, " == 'Yes' ~ Bili_mgdL_cat * relevel(", intvar, ", ref = '", levsint[i], "') + ",
            paste0(modvarstmp, collapse = " + ")
          )),
          family = binomial(link = "logit")
        )
      )
      mod <- summary(pool(modraw))

      out[i + 1, 2] <- mod[2, "estimate"]
      out[i + 1, 3] <- mod[2, "std.error"]
      out[i + 1, 4] <- mod[2, "p.value"]

      if (i == 1) {
        if (nlevsint == 2) {
          out[1, 5] <- last(mod$p.value)
        } else {
          mod_noint <- with(
            impdata,
            glm(
              formula(paste0(
                event, " == 'Yes'~ Bili_mgdL_cat + relevel(", intvar, ", ref = '", levsint[i], "') + ",
                paste0(modvarstmp, collapse = " + ")
              )),
              family = binomial(link = "logit")
            )
          )

          pint <- mice::D1(modraw, mod_noint)
          out[1, 5] <- pint$result[, "P(>F)"]
        }
      }
    }

    if (model == "nb") {
      modraw <- with(impdata, glm.nb(formula(paste0(
        event, " ~ Bili_mgdL_cat * relevel(", intvar, ", ref = '", levsint[i], "') + offset(log(", time, ")) + ", paste0(modvarstmp, collapse = " + ")
      ))))
      mod <- summary(pool(modraw))

      out[i + 1, 2] <- mod[2, "estimate"]
      out[i + 1, 3] <- mod[2, "std.error"]
      out[i + 1, 4] <- mod[2, "p.value"]

      if (i == 1) {
        if (nlevsint == 2) {
          out[1, 5] <- last(mod$p.value)
        } else {
          mod_noint <- with(impdata, glm.nb(formula(paste0(
            event, " ~ Bili_mgdL_cat + relevel(", intvar, ", ref = '", levsint[i], "') + offset(log(", time, ")) + ", paste0(modvarstmp, collapse = " + ")
          ))))

          pint <- mice::D1(modraw, mod_noint)
          out[1, 5] <- pint$result[, "P(>F)"]
        }
      }
    }
    if (model == "cox") {
      modraw <- with(impdata, coxph(formula(paste0(
        "Surv(", time, ",", event, "== 'Yes') ~ Bili_mgdL_cat * relevel(", intvar, ", ref = '", levsint[i], "') + ",
        paste0(modvarstmp, collapse = " + ")
      ))))

      mod <- summary(pool(modraw))

      out[i + 1, 2] <- mod[1, "estimate"]
      out[i + 1, 3] <- mod[1, "std.error"]
      out[i + 1, 4] <- mod[1, "p.value"]

      if (i == 1) {
        if (nlevsint == 2) {
          out[1, 5] <- last(mod$p.value)
        } else {
          mod_noint <- with(impdata, coxph(formula(paste0(
            "Surv(", time, ",", event, "== 'Yes') ~ Bili_mgdL_cat + relevel(", intvar, ", ref = '", levsint[i], "') + ",
            paste0(modvarstmp, collapse = " + ")
          ))))

          pint <- mice::D1(modraw, mod_noint)
          out[1, 5] <- pint$result[, "P(>F)"]
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return(out)
}
outcomessubfunc <- function(event, time = NULL, model, xbreaks = c(0.3, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)) {
  if (model == "log") {
    mod <- with(
      impdata,
      glm(
        formula(paste0(
          event, " == 'Yes' ~ Bili_mgdL_cat + ",
          paste0(modvars, collapse = " + ")
        )),
        family = binomial(link = "logit")
      )
    )
    rownr <- 2
  }
  if (model == "nb") {
    mod <- with(impdata, glm.nb(formula(paste0(
      event, " ~ Bili_mgdL_cat + offset(log(", time, "))  + ", paste0(modvars, collapse = " + ")
    ))))

    rownr <- 2
  }

  if (model == "cox") {
    mod <- with(impdata, coxph(formula(paste0(
      "Surv(", time, ",", event, " == 'Yes') ~ Bili_mgdL_cat + ", paste0(modvars, collapse = " + ")
    ))))

    rownr <- 1
  }

  # same for all models
  mod <- summary(pool(mod))
  out <- tibble(
    pop = "Overall",
    est = mod[rownr, "estimate"],
    se = mod[rownr, "std.error"],
    p = mod[rownr, "p.value"],
    pint = NA
  )

  outcomessub <- outcomessubfunc_inner(
    event = event, time = time, intvar = "ef_cat",
    intvarname = "LVEF (%)", model = model
  )
  outcomessub <- bind_rows(outcomessub, outcomessubfunc_inner(
    event = event, time = time, intvar = "DMSEX",
    intvarname = "Sex", model = model
  ))
  outcomessub <- bind_rows(outcomessub, outcomessubfunc_inner(
    event = event, time = time, intvar = "DMAGE_cat",
    intvarname = "Age (years)", model = model, novars = "ns(DMAGE, df = 4)"
  ))
  out <- bind_rows(out, outcomessub)

  # plot it

  if (model == "log") {
    estname <- "OR"
  }
  if (model == "cox") {
    estname <- "HR"
  }
  if (model == "nb") {
    estname <- "RR"
  }
  xname <- paste0("Adjusted ", estname, "\n(95% CI)")

  subplot <- out %>%
    mutate(
      order = 1:n(),
      lci = exp(est - global_z05 * se),
      uci = exp(est + global_z05 * se),
      est = exp(est),
      cols = factor(case_when(p >= 0.05 ~ 2, est >= 0 ~ 3, est < 0 ~ 1)),
      estci = if_else(!is.na(est), paste0(
        fn(est, 2), " (",
        fn(lci, 2), "-",
        fn(uci, 2), ")"
      ), ""),
      `P-value\ninteraction` = if_else(is.na(pint), "", fn(pint, dig = 3, p = TRUE)),
      pop = str_replace_all(pop, "<=", "\u2264"),
      pop = str_replace_all(pop, ">=", "\u2265")
    ) %>%
    rename(!!sym(xname) := estci)

  subplot$` ` <- paste(rep(" ", nrow(subplot)), collapse = " ")
  colnames(subplot)[1] <- "  "

  tm <- forest_theme(
    core = list(bg_params = list(fill = c("#F0F0F0", "white"))),
    base_size = 11,
    refline_gp = gpar(lty = "solid"),
    ci_col = global_cols[1],
    ci_lwd = 2.5,
    arrow_length = 0.08,
    colhead = list(
      fg_params = list(hjust = 0.5, x = 0.5) # Centers header text
    )
  )

  # Draw the forest plot with rearranged columns
  p <- forest(subplot[, c(1, 12, 10, 11)],
    est = subplot$est,
    lower = subplot$lci,
    upper = subplot$uci,
    ci_column = 2,
    sizes = 1.25,
    # nudge_y = 0.35,
    x_trans = "log",
    arrow_lab = c("High TBili less harmfull", "High TBili more harmfull"),
    xlim = c(min(xbreaks), max(xbreaks)),
    ticks_at = xbreaks,
    theme = tm
  )
  p <- edit_plot(p,
    col = c(3, 4),
    which = "text",
    hjust = unit(0.5, "npc"),
    x = unit(0.5, "npc"),
  )

  p <- edit_plot(p,
    row = subplot %>% filter(cols == 2) %>% pull(order), col = 2, which = "ci",
    gp = gpar(col = global_cols[2], fill = global_cols[2])
  )

  create_pptx(p, width = 4, height = 4)
  p
}
```
